description: This file defines the `Email` class, which represents an email message with properties such as sender, recipient, subject, template, and tokens for template substitution.

classes.name: Email
classes.description: A serializable Java class modeling an email message with attributes for sender, recipient, subject, template, and template tokens.

methods.name: getFrom
methods.description: Returns the sender's name or identifier.

methods.name: setFrom
methods.description: Sets the sender's name or identifier.

methods.name: getTemplateName
methods.description: Returns the name of the email template.

methods.name: setTemplateName
methods.description: Sets the name of the email template.

methods.name: getTemplateTokens
methods.description: Returns the map of tokens used for template substitution.

methods.name: setTemplateTokens
methods.description: Sets the map of tokens for template substitution.

methods.name: getFromEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address of the sender.

methods.name: setFromEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address of the sender.
